paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者回忆一次安排的结束时间与后来情况不同，但不确定另一条关于反复想到饮酒的陈述是否符合。两条可以分别保留，不需要拼成意志力或依赖程度的结论。指南不知道摄入量、发生次数或原计划是否可行；它不认可任何自定限额，也不要求再去饮酒、测试限度或改变摄入来补证。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls a planned ending differing from what followed, while remaining unsure about a statement on thoughts returning to drinking. These descriptions can stay separate without a verdict on willpower or dependence. The guide knows neither consumption, event frequency nor whether the plan was feasible. It endorses no personal limit and requests no drinking, limit test or consumption change as evidence.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡区分“原本打算”“记得的情况”“仍然不知道的部分”。可以只讨论虚构例子，不交代数量或私人经过，听者也不据此判定自制或提供安全限额。想讨论实际顾虑时，不需要先算出总分；这张卡不指派任何饮酒或停酒行动。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates an intention, what is recalled and what remains unknown. Discuss the fictional example without amounts or private events. A listener need not grade self-control or supply a safe allowance. An actual concern requires no total score first; the card prescribes no drinking or stopping action.

paragraphs.en: These additional scenes and conversation cards are original FermatMind Editorial material for optional reading, not a drinking experiment, clinical screen or measurement evidence. The twenty statements and four six-category records of five remain unchanged. Cannot judge, no experience and withholding stay separate from does not describe; nothing is combined into a safety tier. Four weeks is a recall aid, without established reliability, validity, norms or English–Chinese equivalence. This content assesses neither dependence, withdrawal nor a safe change in drinking and supplies no self-management plan. Full guides require no answers; support has no count threshold. Public sharing contains only the title and entry, without answers, counts or private experiences.

paragraphs.zh: 补充原创情境：虚构读者记得一项普通共同活动被推迟，但不愿重述与别人对影响的分歧，也说不清其他活动是否受到影响。他可以保留自己一侧的有限描述，不把未知补成没有影响。指南不了解当时责任、其他人的经历或原因，不能判断过错与严重程度；无需联系当事人求证或重开争论。
paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls postponing an ordinary shared activity, keeps a disagreement about its effect private and is unsure about other activities. Their limited account can remain without turning unknown effects into absent effects. The guide knows neither responsibilities, others’ experiences nor causes and judges no fault or seriousness. No confirmation from others or reopened argument is required.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡可以只说明“我想讨论的一件日常影响”“不想公开的细节”“尚不清楚的背景”。可以只读，不拿计数评价谁负责或比较关系；听者可以了解顾虑，不要求完成所有主题或证明某种固定模式。实际支持不取决于影响条数。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card can name one daily effect to discuss, details to keep private and background still unclear. Read without using counts to assign responsibility or compare connections. A listener can hear a concern without every theme completed or proof of a fixed pattern. Actual support depends on no count of effects.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader is unsure whether they understood an actual medicine-and-alcohol compatibility question. Cannot judge can remain distinct from no relevant experience; low counts in another theme give no permission. The guide checks neither medicines, alertness, transport nor safety and requests no recreated setting, reaction test or tried combination. A real question needs appropriate professional information.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡只区分“实际顾虑”“网页没有的信息”“需要另行专业判断的问题”。可以只读虚构卡，不公布用药、地点或事件；听者不应从类别推安全、同意或法律责任。公开指南不是处理危险场合的操作说明，实际紧急问题沿用页面已有支持信息。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card separates an actual concern, information absent from the webpage and questions needing separate professional judgment. Read the fictional card without medicines, places or events disclosed. A listener should infer neither safety, consent nor legal responsibility from categories. The public guide is no procedure for a hazardous setting; existing support information still applies to urgent concerns.

paragraphs.en: In an additional original scene, a reader recalls a changed bodily feeling, remains unsure about its relation to drinking and keeps symptoms and timing private. Uncertainty can remain; two overlapping impressions of changed effect are not two independent medical symptoms. The guide establishes neither dependence, withdrawal nor an all-clear finding. The scene assigns no delayed drink, sudden stop, another drink or recreated discomfort as a test.

paragraphs.zh: 可选交流卡：“我对身体感受有顾虑；原因还不清楚；我想在适当的个别医疗场合讨论。”可以只读，不写病史或用网页代替评估。听者无需给出饮酒改变方案或要求先重复体验；沿用原有医疗支持边界，不用计数判断改变是否安全。
paragraphs.en: An optional conversation card can name a bodily concern, leave its cause unknown and place discussion in an appropriate individual medical setting. Read without writing a history or replacing assessment with a webpage. A listener need not supply a drinking-change plan or require a repeated experience. Existing medical-support boundaries remain; counts decide no safe change.
